policy.tokenizer: Compare vocabulary, special tokens and serialized fast-tokenizer backend; slow tokenizers are rejected.
policy.resume: Restore optimizer, scheduler, scaler, EMA, queue, RNG and data progress from training_state in the training engine.
policy.architecture_changes: Create a new compatibility directory; never bypass validation to reuse incompatible weights.
policy.finetune: Use load_pretrained(path) to rebuild the model and fast tokenizer offline from the checkpoint. Use its returned input config for preprocessing. Initialize a new optimizer and schedule; do not restore pretraining training_state.
policy.configuration: Save all config values in run_config; classify every config key. Compare compatibility and resume_fields before resume. Fine-tune restores compatibility fields and starts a new training configuration.
policy.compatibility: Source and dependency versions must match exactly. Older schemas require explicit migration and are rejected.
policy.checkpoint_root: CHECKPOINT_DIR resolved from the project root; OUTPUT_DIR is for logs and other outputs.
